label: nxd-data-product-query: platform-routed cross-dp joins replace client-side compiler
notes: Cross-DP queries now route through the platform's query system DP (server-side harvest/merge/gate/join); strict mode and the client-side compiler are removed. Scenario prompt/checks modernized off the strict-mode framing in the same PR (numeric fan-out discriminators). run2's single q6 miss (confusable dispensed metric) did not reproduce in run3 — single-run nondeterminism, not a regression; run1 against the stale strict-mode prompt was discarded.

checks.why: The trace shows list_models and describe_model (all 5 models) called and returned before the first run_semantic_query, with concept names taken from the describe output rather than guessed or read from a catalog file.

The agent invoked the nxd-data-product-query skill and reached the three tools via the skill's own mcp_http MCP client over the discovered EVAL_MCP_ENDPOINT, never inventing a SQL connection, reading fixtures, or authoring a raw SQL string (compiled_sql was returned by run_semantic_query).
Q1 ran run_semantic_query with measures=[subject_count] on subjects and answered '4 subjects' from the returned row.

Q3 explicitly recognized titer (assays) and units_dispensed (dispenses) as different grains, ran them as two separate per-model queries sliced by subject_country, and presented both without a single combined fan-out call.
Q4 ran visit_duration_min, titer_sum, and units_dispensed as three separate per-grain queries sharing subject_country and combined the results in presentation only, never merging grains in one call.
For Q5 the agent surfaced the titer_sum vs titer_avg ambiguity and asked the analyst which was meant instead of silently picking one.
Q6 echoed the resolved choice as 'units_dispensed (the quantity metric, matching how much)', framing it as the sum-of-units quantity rather than a count, so it did not silently guess.
Q7 selected serious_ae_count (the serious-only flag metric) by ae_term, not ae_count.
Q8 selected ae_count (all adverse events) by ae_term as the default plain reading.
Q9 flagged prescriber_npi as pii:true, noted it is not in units_dispensed's compatible_dimensions and would be rejected/governed, and declined to return prescriber identities.
Q10 selected visit_count on the visits grain by visit_type, not subject_count.
For every question the agent restated the resolved metric/dimension selection in plain language using describe_model meanings and explicitly distinguished confusable metrics.

verdict.summary: The agent discovered the catalog before querying, stayed on the strict MCP path with no raw SQL, correctly resolved every confusable metric and PII/chasm case (clarifying Q5/Q9), so all 12 checks pass.

Q1 ran subject_count on the subjects model and answered 4 from the returned row.

The agent surfaced the titer_sum vs titer_avg ambiguity for 'titer level' and explicitly asked which metric rather than guessing.
For Q6 the agent silently picked units_dispensed and never surfaced or distinguished the confusable dispense_count metric, unlike its explicit handling of the other confusables.
Q7 selected serious_ae_count (the serious-only flag metric) by ae_term, not ae_count.
Q8 selected ae_count (all adverse events) by ae_term as the default plain reading.
The agent flagged prescriber_npi as PII/governed and noted the values were masked to null server-side rather than exposing prescriber identities.

verdict.summary: The agent executed the governed toolchain correctly on nearly every check, but failed q6 by silently choosing units_dispensed without distinguishing the confusable dispense_count metric.

Q1 ran subject_count on the subjects model and answered 4 from the returned rows.
Q3 returned per-grain values (US titer 300, units 90) via a compiler-pre-aggregated join (agg_assays/agg_dispenses CTEs), not inflated double-counted totals.
Q4 returned fan-out-safe per-grain US values of visit duration 240, titer 300, and units 90 via per-subject pre-aggregation before joining.
For Q5 the agent surfaced the titer_sum vs titer_avg ambiguity and asked the user to choose rather than silently picking one.
For Q6 the agent explicitly chose units_dispensed over dispense_count and echoed that distinction rather than silently guessing.
Q7 selected serious_ae_count (the serious-only flag metric) by ae_term, not ae_count.
Q8 selected ae_count (all adverse events) by ae_term as the plain-count default.

Q10 selected visit_count on the visits grain (explicitly not subject_count) by visit_type.
For every question the final answer restates the resolved metric/dimension selection in plain language using describe_model meanings and calls out the confusable alternatives it rejected.

verdict.summary: The agent discovered the catalog via the MCP toolchain before querying, picked the correct confusable metrics or clarified, returned fan-out-safe per-grain numbers, surfaced PII governance, authored no raw SQL, and echoed each selection — all checks pass.
